text:
elliot: Quick sync request from Corsair Compute — they shipped a C-Edge RevB board and want a tightly reproducible perf/W benchmark for our 20B model. Goal: publish joint numbers for marketplace listing and a co-blog if stable.
marta: nice. ask them for exact firmware/kernel labels and power probe method. Corsair said they can provide both IPMI and a hardware power meter.
corsair-eng: we can do IPMI + external powermeter. firmware: cedge-revb-2026-04-30. kernel-tune: cedge-htune-v3. we'll also share a small flash script.
elliot: propose plan: two kernel configs (redwood-default, cedge-htune-v3), two runs each, 2h steady-state, 10m warmup, sample power at 1s, thermals at 5s. capture raw series and trimmed stats (mean, p95).
ops-bot: Suggested lab slots: 2026-06-02 20:00 PT or 2026-06-03 02:00 PT. Please confirm preferred.
elliot: pick 2026-06-02 20:00 PT. ops-bot: booking confirmed corsair-bay-2 2026-06-02T20:00:00-07:00 booking_id=CB-77234
pm: pip: can you own the reproducibility bundle? needs docker tag, env vars, and a run.sh that partners can run locally.
pip: yes. i'll create experiments/corsair/repobundle and include docker tag: redwood/perf-run:2026-06-02 and a minimal compose.
marketing: Heads-up: if numbers are clean we want a co-branded line for the marketplace tile: "Optimized for Corsair C-Edge: best-in-class performance per watt for 20B serving". Legal will want embargo details.
elliot: schema for collector payload (please stick to this): run_id, partner, model, kernel_label, firmware_id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, thermal_max_c, token_latency_p95_ms, raw_power_series_url, artifact_url, panic_count.
corsair-eng: we'll provide raw_power_series in CSV and IPMI logs; firmware_id included. kernel logs gathered to artifact.zip.
marta: infra notes: dedicate 3 identical nodes in perf-pool with isolated VLAN; use a single ingress gateway to avoid egress variance; NTP sync enforced. Also add a simple watchdog to reboot on hung kernel.
elliot: sample run command i'll document:
```
RUN_ID="corsair-cedge-2026-06-02-01"
./run_bench --model redwood-20b --seq 4096 --batch 2 --streaming --duration 7200 --warmup 600 --collector http://collector.internal:8200/post
```
pip: reproducibility bundle will include run.sh that sets RUN_ID and uploads artifacts to our collector with tags: corsair, perfW, 20B.
marketing: embargo ask: 72 hours after we hand validated numbers to Corsair. legal ok?
marta: legal green for 72h embargo window if both parties sign. add to runbook.
ops-bot: Reminder set: dry-run 2026-06-01T09:00:00-07:00. Reminder created.
elliot: risk list: thermal throttling after ~90m observed in older boards, IPMI dropouts, powermeter sync drift. Mitigations: preflight thermal stress, powermeter sync check, and a calibration step using fixed load.
corsair-eng: we will disable auto-firmware-update and run a preflight stress. also share a small calibration harness.
pip: action items: pip -> bundle + compose, marta -> infra + collector mapping, corsair-eng -> kernel scripts + raw logs, elliot -> perf script + baseline on hosted infra for delta. target dry-run 2026-06-01 09:00 PT; official 2026-06-02 20:00 PT.
marketing: i'll draft a PR template and co-blog outline after we have validated numbers.
elliot: i'll push a short runbook to experiments/corsair/runbook.md in the repo today. ping here when uploaded and i'll do a preflight checklist.
ops-bot: lab booking note appended to booking CB-77234: corsair-eng contact: @corsair-eng.
marketing: thanks all. short and clear thread, please keep updates in the repo and ping when artifacts are uploaded. :rocket:
